items.title: Apple’s Biggest Win This Week Isn’t the New iPhone
items.summary: It has been a successful first two weeks for  Apple’s  new CEO, John Ternus.  First at the Emmys, where Apple TV dominated the trophy haul, and then in the battle for auto makers’ infotainment systems.  Last Wednesday, Ternus graduated from his usual supporting role at Apple’s annual launch event to center stage.
